scope: Portable byte-exact original screenshots for the 32 adopted browser-gameplay-api scenarios; one PNG per scenario.
policies: Every source scenario is independently passed and adopted by the coverage manifest.
Images are copied byte for byte; no render, crop, redraw, recompression or browser rerun.
All paths are relative to the repository except archivePath, which is relative to this index.
Actual RAF observations accompany each selection; sequential screenshot timing is not claimed to be atomic.
Support HP and CSS assertions belong to the separate atomic probe; later screenshot HP may include real reflection.

exclusions.reason: Four stale app.js source cases excluded by the adopted manifest.
Failed older desktop pure-support scenario; replaced by the passed 08:17 case.
